blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.

blocks.en: 1  INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In modern diagnostic radiology, high-throughput volumetric X-ray modalities—most notably cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT)—serve as the frontline standard for evaluating mineralized anatomical structures [ 1 , 2 ] . However, the physical principles of cone-beam image formation impose a severe diagnostic blind spot: wide-cone scatter radiation, truncated field-of-view artifacts, and low contrast-to-noise ratios render soft-tissue structures visually homogeneous and diagnostically uninformative to the human observer [ 3 ] . As a result, non-calcified abnormalities—whether occult inflammatory processes, fluid effusions, or early soft-tissue lesions incidentally captured within the field of view—remain undetected during routine radiographic procedures. Definitive soft-tissue evaluation strictly requires magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) [ 4 , 5 ] , whose deployment as a population-wide screening tool is precluded by high operational costs, limited scanner accessibility, prolonged acquisition protocols, and patient contraindications [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 在现代诊断放射学中,高通量量的体积X射线方式——最显著的是锥束计算成像仪(CBCT)——作为评估矿物解剖结构的前沿标准[1,2]。 然而,锥束成像的物理原理强加了一个严重的诊断盲点:宽孔散射,截断视场的文物,低对比度与噪声率使得软质组织结构在视觉上是同质的,诊断上对人类观察者不具有启发性[3]. 因此,非计算出的异常现象——无论是隐蔽的炎症过程、流体喷洒,还是视界内偶然发现的早期软质病变——在常规的射线学过程中仍然无法发现。 确定性软质问题评价严格要求磁共振成像[MRI][4,5],由于操作成本高,扫描仪的可访问性有限,采购协议延长,以及病人的反感,无法将其作为全人口的筛选工具加以部署[6]。

blocks.en: This clinical dichotomy is acutely exemplified in the diagnosis of temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders [ 4 , 7 ] . While CBCT is routinely acquired in dental and maxillofacial workflows and achieves superior diagnostic accuracy and sensitivity over MRI in detecting osseous alterations such as cortical erosions and osteophytes (87% vs. 68% sensitivity, respectively) [ 8 ] , it provides no direct visual delineation of the articular disc or synovial cavity [ 2 ] . Clinicians relying on CBCT are forced to infer soft-tissue status indirectly from surrogate geometric measurements of the joint space width. While these linear measurements are highly reproducible in themselves (ICC > 0.90) [ 9 ] , relying on them as indirect predictors for articular disc displacement suffers from limited diagnostic validity. Specifically, surrogate geometric evaluation exhibits high sensitivity and NPV, making it a viable preliminary screen, but severely lacks specificity (often below 50%), resulting in a disproportionately high false-positive rate and low predictive power [ 2 , 10 ] . Yet, from a physical standpoint, X-ray attenuation differentials within the soft-tissue Hounsfield Unit (HU) spectrum ( [ − 300,300 ] [-300,300] HU) are not absent in CBCT; rather, they exist as subtle, visually imperceptible ( sub-visual ) statistical variations buried beneath stochastic photon noise and overshadowed by high-magnitude osseous boundaries [ 11 ] . Analogous to how deep neural networks have uncovered occult systemic biomarkers from routine retinal photographs [ 12 ] , we hypothesize that a domain-tailored 3D computational pipeline can isolate these sub-visual soft-tissue signatures directly from routine CBCT scans, enabling opportunistic cross-modal screening of pathologies traditionally verifiable only via MRI.
blocks.zh: 这种临床上的二分法在对节奏性关节障碍[4,7]的诊断中得到了显著的体现. 虽然CBCT经常在牙科和最大乳房工作流程中获得,并在检测皮质侵蚀和骨质动物等骨骼改变(分别为87%和68%的敏感性)[8]时,在核磁共振中达到优异的诊断精度和敏感性,但是它并没有直接对动脉盘或体腔进行直观划分[2]. 依赖CBCT的临床医生被迫从联合空间宽度的代位几何测量中间接推断软组织状态. 虽然这些线性测量本身极易复制(ICC > 0.90[9]),但依靠这些测量作为动脉盘位移的间接预测器,诊断有效性有限。 具体地说,代位几何评价显示出高度的敏感性和NPV,使它成为一个可行的初步屏幕,但严重缺乏特异性(往往低于50%),导致不相称的高假阳性率和低预测力[2,10]. 然而,从物理角度来看,软质Hounsfield(HU)谱系内的X射线衰减差([−300,300][-300,300]HU])在CBCT中并不存在;相反,它们作为隐蔽的、视觉上无法辨识的(次视觉的)统计变化而存在,埋藏在色谱光子噪声之下,被高宽的振荡线所遮盖。 类似地,深神经网络从常规视网膜照片中发现了神秘的系统生物标记[12],我们假设,一个域状的3D计算管道能够直接从常规的CBCT扫描中分离出这些子视觉软质组织特征,从而能够对传统上只能通过核磁共振可核查的病理进行机会性跨模式筛选。

blocks.en: Extracting these sub-visual signatures to build a robust predictive pipeline requires overcoming three fundamental methodological barriers:
blocks.zh: 要提取这些次级视觉特征,以建立一个强有力的预测管道,就需要克服三个基本的方法障碍:

blocks.en: First, training cross-modal 3D predictors is bottlenecked by the extreme scarcity of synchronously acquired paired datasets [ 13 , 14 ] . Because soft-tissue states such as synovial inflammation fluctuate over time, pairing routine CBCT scans with ground-truth MRI reports requires a tight temporal inclusion window ( ≤ 30 \leq 30 days between examinations, compared to the 90-day intervals common in clinical practice). Under such rigorous filtering, verified clinical cohorts rarely exceed a few hundred volumes. In this extreme low-data regime, end-to-end supervised training of high-capacity 3D convolutional or transformer networks inevitably degenerates into memorizing stochastic background noise and patient-specific bone contours [ 13 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 首先,培训跨模式的3D预测器因同步获取的对等数据集极度稀缺而瓶颈[13,14]. 因为软质问题,如血栓炎等状态随时间而波动,将常规CBCT扫描与地面真核磁共振报告配对需要紧凑的时空包容窗口(检查间隔30~leq30天,而临床实践中常见的间隔为90天). 在如此严格的过滤下,经核实的临床组群很少超过几百卷. 在这种极端低数据制度下,对高功率的3D转录或变压器网络的端到端监督训练不可避免地退化成记忆性背景噪声和患者特有的骨轮廓[13,15].

blocks.en: Second, while self-supervised learning (SSL) via Masked Autoencoders (MAE) [ 16 ] offers a powerful paradigm for learning anatomical priors from large unlabeled archives [ 17 ] , its direct application to 3D medical volumes is structurally and mathematically bottlenecked. Standard sparse 3D MAEs discard 75% of volumetric patches during encoding, severing continuous 3D anatomical neighborhoods. This topological discontinuity is a recognized fundamental challenge, forcing recent frameworks to mitigate the loss of spatial coherence through computationally complex workarounds, such as integrating sparse convolutions [ 18 ] or employing dual-branch global-local feature aggregation modules [ 19 ] . More critically, conventional MAE pre-training relies on voxel-wise mean squared error (L2 loss) [ 20 , 21 ] . Across a 3000 HU dynamic range where soft tissues occupy a narrow fraction of the intensity spectrum, conventional L2 optimization disproportionately penalizes high-amplitude errors at high-density cortical bone interfaces. As recently demonstrated, MSE-based optimization acts as a low-pass filter for fine details, overwhelmingly preserving high-amplitude dominant edges (macro-geometry) while heavily blurring subtle high-frequency textural features [ 22 ] . Consequently, encoders trained with standard L2 loss and applied to CBCT become hyper-focused on macroscopic osseous geometry, failing to resolve the critical, low-contrast textural gradients of intra-articular soft tissues necessary for opportunistic screening [ 23 ] . Consequently, L 2 L_{2} -trained encoders fail to learn oriented 3D morphological geometry, relying instead on isotropic local texture statistics [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 第二,虽然通过Masked Autoencodes(MAE)[16]进行自我监督的学习(SSL)为从大型无标签档案中学习解剖学前科提供了一个强有力的范式[17],但其直接应用于3D医学卷在结构和数学上是瓶颈的. 标准稀疏的3D MAEs在编码过程中丢弃75%的卷状补丁,分割连续的3D解剖学街区. 这种地形上的不连续性是一个公认的基本挑战,迫使最近的框架通过计算上复杂的工作来减少空间一致性的丧失,例如整合稀少的演化[18]或使用双分支的全球-局部特征汇总模块[19]。 更为关键的是,常规的MAE预训依赖于voxel-wise-平均平方差错(L2损失)[20,21]. 在3000HU动态范围内,软组织占据了强度光谱的一小部分,常规L2优化在高密度皮质骨质界面上对高照度误差进行过度的处罚. 正如最近所证明的那样,基于MSE的优化可以充当细微细节的低通滤波器,压倒性地保留高纬度优势边(macro-geometry),同时严重模糊微妙的高频纹理特征[22]. 因此,经过标准L2损失培训并应用于CBCT的编码器变得过于注重宏视振荡几何学,未能解决机会性筛查所必需的动脉内软组织的关键、低连续纹理梯度[23]。 因此,L2 L_{2} - 训练有素的编码器无法学习面向3D的形态几何学,而是依赖于异热带局部纹理统计[24].

blocks.en: Third, even if a self-supervised encoder successfully captures sub-visual soft-tissue features, feeding a complete peri-articular volume into a downstream classifier on a small paired cohort results in an unfavorable signal-to-noise ratio. The high spatial variance of adjacent cranial and mandibular bone structures overwhelms the subtle intra-articular signal unless the classification head is deterministically restricted to the relevant local anatomical region [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 第三,即使一个自我监督的编码器成功捕捉到次级视觉软质组织特征,将完整的近缘体积输入到小对联群的下游分类器上,导致信号对噪比不理想. 相邻颅骨和mandibular骨结构的高度空间差异压倒了细微的动脉内信号,除非分类头被定型限制在相关的局部解剖区[25].

blocks.en: In our companion methodological study, we introduced BertsWin [ 24 ] , a full-grid hybrid 3D masked autoencoder that resolves topological sparsity by retaining all masked and visible tokens within a linear-complexity shifted-window transformer [ 26 ] , coupled with the GCond optimizer [ 27 ] and an anatomy-aware variance-decomposed objective ( PhysLoss ) based on Theil’s decomposition [ 28 ] . In that work, we showed that combining PhysLoss with GCond is the only pre-training regime that acquires statistically significant sensitivity to 3D anatomical chirality (distinguishing true contralateral left–right joints from synthetic reflections, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) while maximizing intra-patient structural similarity ( 0.791 0.791 ) relative to inter-patient noise [ 24 ] . In the present paper, we demonstrate that these exact structural properties are the prerequisite for extracting visually occult, MRI-verified soft-tissue pathologies from routine CBCT scans on a restricted cohort of 212 joints. The primary contributions of this work are threefold: 1. Discovery of Sub-Visual Soft-Tissue Signatures in CBCT: We provide the first quantitative proof that MRI-verified synovial effusion can be detected directly from routine CBCT volumes with statistically and clinically significant accuracy ( ROC AUC = 0.793 ± 0.036 \text{ROC AUC}=0.793\pm 0.036 , surpassing the Hosmer–Lemeshow clinical discrimination threshold of 0.70 0.70 [ 29 ] ). Crucially, we prove via 3 × 10 3\times 10 -fold cross-validation that this diagnostic signal is captured exclusively by the chirality-aware PhysLoss + GCond encoder, whereas standard L 2 L_{2} and unmasked multi-component variance (MVC) encoders collapse to random guessing ( ROC AUC = 0.465 ​ – ​ 0.513 \text{ROC AUC}=0.465\text{--}0.513 ). 2. Overfitting Mitigation via Frozen Probing and Deterministic 3D Token Cropping: We show that any parametric adaptation of the 86.28 × 10 6 86.28\times 10^{6} -parameter backbone (including partial fine-tuning and Low-Rank Adaptation) induces overfitting in the low-data regime. By combining a strictly frozen encoder with an automated Attention U-Net localization module ( ASSD = 0.537 \text{ASSD}=0.537 mm) that crops an 8 3 8^{3} token sub-volume around the condylar zenith, we eliminate 81% of background osseous variance and isolate the intra-articular diagnostic signal. 3. Delineation of Direct Soft-Tissue vs. Secondary Osseous Detection Limits: By comparing synovial effusion against articular disc displacement, we establish the physical boundaries of cross-modal inference at N = 212 N=212 joints, demonstrating why volumetric fluid accumulation is directly detectable in the soft-tissue latent space while thin fibrocartilage displacement requires steering the classifier toward secondary cortical bone remodeling ( ROC AUC = 0.679 \text{ROC AUC}=0.679 , Sensitivity = 0.840 \text{Sensitivity}=0.840 ).
blocks.zh: 在我们的配套方法研究中,我们引入了BertsWin [24],一个全网混合3D蒙面自动编码器,通过将所有蒙面和可见的代号保留在线性复合的转向窗变压器[26]中来解决地形痉挛问题,再加上GCond优化器[27]和基于Theil的分解[28]的解剖-意识差异分解目标(PhysLos). 在这项工作中,我们表明,将物理损失与GCond结合是唯一在统计学上对3D解剖性具有显著敏感性的预培训制度(将正反左-右关节与合成反射区分开来,p < 0.001 p < 0.001),同时最大限度地扩大患者内部结构的相似性(0.791 0.791)相对于患者间噪音[24]。 在本文中,我们表明,这些确切的结构特性是从常规的CBCT扫描中提取视障、核磁共振经核磁共振的软组织病理的212个限制组群的先决条件。 这项工作的主要贡献有三: 1. CBCT中二级视觉软体组织签名的发现:我们提供了第一个定量证据,证明核磁共振经核实的叠加液可直接从CBCT常规卷中检测到,在统计和临床上具有显著的精确度(ROC AUC=0.793±0.036\text{ROC AUC=0.793\pm 0.036,超过了Hosmer-Lemeshow临床歧视阈值0.700.70[29])。 关键是,我们通过3×10 3×10 次10倍的交叉验证证明,这个诊断信号完全由知觉-知觉-hysLoss + GCond编码器捕获,而标准L 2 L_{2}和未整齐的多元件差异(MVC)编码器崩溃成随机猜测(ROC AUC=0.465=0.513=text{ROC AUC=0.465=text{-}0.513). 2. 通过冷冻探测和确定3D托肯作物方法过度适应缓解: 我们显示,86.28×10 6 86.28\times 10^{6}-参数主干线(包括部分微调和低Rank适应)的任何参数调整都会导致低数据制度中的偏差。 通过将严格冷冻的编码器与自动的注意U-Net本地化模块(ASSD = 0.537\text{ASSD}=0.537 mm)结合,将8 3 8^{3}的符号子卷绕圆锥子圈,我们消除了81%的背景偏差,隔离了动脉内诊断信号. 3. 直接软质组织与二级骨骼检测极限的界限: 通过将血清分泌与动脉盘位移相比较,我们在N = 212 N = 212关节上确定了跨模式推论的物理界限,说明为什么在软质潜在空间可直接检测体积流体积积,而薄纤维化转移则需要引导分类器转向二次皮质骨质改造(ROC AUC = 0.679\text{ROC AUC = 0.679,灵敏度= 0.840\Text{敏感度= 0.840)。

斯科尔科沃科学和技术研究所机构道德委员会批准了这一回顾性研究(2026年4月17日的议定书),在收集数据之前得到了所有与会者的书面知情同意。

blocks.en: Self-supervised representation learning was performed on the single-center clinical CBCT archive previously detailed in our companion study [ 24 ] . Briefly, the dataset comprised 3,853 maxillofacial CBCT scans acquired at an isotropic resolution of 0.2 0.2 mm, from which standardized 400 × 400 × 400 400\times 400\times 400 voxel volumes ( 80 3 80^{3} mm) centered on the TMJ were automatically extracted. Strict patient-level partitioning yielded 6,550 training joints and 1,156 validation joints to prevent data leakage. Voxel intensities were clipped to the [ − 1011 , 1992 ] [-1011,1992] HU interval and Z-normalized using statistics derived exclusively from the training split. Additionally, an external verification array of 2,199,444 head-and-neck CT slices from public repositories [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] was utilized strictly to evaluate gradient field stability across heterogeneous inputs.
blocks.zh: 在单中心临床的CBCT档案上进行了自我监督的表述学习,该档案先前已在我们的伴研究中详细介绍[24]. 简而言之,数据集包括以0.2毫米的异色分辨率获得的3 853个最大CBCT扫描,其中以TMJ为中心的400×400×400×400\400\400\400\400 v400 v400ox400 volumes(80 3 80^{3}mm)自动提取. 严格患者层次分流,形成6,550个培训关节和1,156个验证关节,防止数据泄漏. Voxel 强度被剪切到 [− 1011, 1992] [1011,1992] HU间隔和Z-常态化使用完全来自训练分裂的统计数据. 此外,严格利用公共储存库的2,199,444个头部和颈部CT片段的外部核查阵列[30、31、32]来评价不同投入的梯度场稳定性。

blocks.en:
To evaluate cross-modal detection of soft-tissue pathologies, we curated a clinical cohort of 99 patients (212 TMJs, including 14 longitudinal follow-up scans) who underwent both CBCT and MRI examinations.
In routine clinical practice, the diagnostic interval between CBCT and MRI frequently reaches 90 days; however, to minimize label noise arising from natural disease progression or symptom resolution between scans, we enforced a strict inclusion threshold requiring an inter-scan interval of ≤ 30 \leq 30 days.
To ensure that downstream classifiers did not overfit to the acquisition artifacts of a single device, the validation cohort incorporated CBCT volumes acquired across six different scanner models with isotropic voxel spacings ranging from 0.2 0.2 mm to 0.4 0.4 mm.
blocks.zh:
为了评估对软组织病症的跨模式检测,我们诊治了99名病人(212名TMJ,包括14名纵向后续扫描),他们同时接受了CBCT和MRI检查。
在常规的临床实践中,CBCT和核磁共振之间的诊断间隔经常达到90天;然而,为了在扫描之间尽量减少自然疾病发展或症状分辨率所产生的标签噪声,我们实施了严格的包含阈值,要求扫描间隔30天。
为了确保下游分类器不会过度适合单一设备的购置文物,鉴定组将CBCT卷装入通过六种不同扫描器模型获得的CBCT卷,其异体氧氧间距从0.2毫米到0.4毫米不等。

blocks.en:
To avoid the subjectivity and annotation overhead of manual voxel-level delineation on low-contrast volumes, joint-level binary labels were obtained from the corresponding clinical MRI reports via automated extraction from unstructured clinical text.
Two primary diagnostic targets were formulated: (1) presence of synovial effusion (intra-articular fluid accumulation/inflammatory edema; positive-to-negative ratio 1 : 3 1:3 ) and (2) articular disc displacement (positive-to-negative ratio 3 : 1 3:1 ).
A third potential target, osseous destruction, exhibited a 1 : 4 1:4 class imbalance, leaving only 4–5 positive instances per validation fold during 10-fold cross-validation; preliminary runs confirmed that this extreme sparsity caused systematic classifier collapse toward majority-class prediction, warranting its exclusion from the quantitative protocol.
To guarantee label fidelity when parsing unstructured MRI reports, a three-tiered verification protocol was implemented: primary independent annotation by clinical residents, parallel automated diagnostic extraction using a large language model (Gemini Pro, Google, Mountain View, CA, USA), and final arbitration of all discrepancies—alongside blind quality-control sampling of concordant cases—by a senior gnathologist with over 25 years of clinical experience.
blocks.zh:
为了避免人工对低孔隙量的阴道水平划分的主观性和注释性,通过从无结构的临床文本中自动提取,从相应的临床核磁共振报告中获得了联合级二进制标签.
制定了两项主要诊断目标:(1) 存在血清分泌(内脉流体积积/发炎水肿;阳性对阴性比1:1:3)和(2) 动脉盘移位(阳性对阴性比3:1)。
第三个潜在目标, Osseous destruction, 显示1: 4 1: 4 类不平衡, 在10倍的交叉验证中,每个验证折叠只留下4-5个正例; 初步运行证实,这种极端的痉挛导致系统分级者向多数类预测崩溃,因此有理由将其排除在定量协议之外。
为了保证在分析无结构的核磁共振报告时的标签诚实性,实施了三级核查协议:临床居民的初级独立注释、使用大型语言模型(Gemini Pro、Google、Mountain View、CA、美国)的平行自动诊断提取,以及一名具有25年临床经验的高级肾科医生对所有不一致情况进行盲目质量控制抽样的最后仲裁。

blocks.en: 2.2  Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Pre-Training
blocks.zh: 2.2 物理学指导3D 自我监督的预训

blocks.en:
To extract robust 3D features without supervision, we utilize our previously introduced BertsWin framework [ 24 ] .
Rather than repeating the exhaustive architectural benchmarks from our companion study, we summarize the core methodological design choices that directly govern downstream cross-modal sensitivity:
blocks.zh:
为了在不受监督的情况下提取强力的三维特性,我们利用我们以前引入的BertsWin框架[24].
我们不重复我们共同研究中详尽无遗的建筑基准,而是总结直接制约下游跨模式敏感性的核心方法设计选择:

blocks.en:
Standard sparse 3D masked autoencoders (such as MONAI MAE-ViT [ 33 , 16 ] ) discard 75% of volumetric patches during encoding, severing continuous 3D anatomical neighborhoods. This topological discontinuity is a recognized fundamental bottleneck in volumetric imaging, forcing recent state-of-the-art frameworks to mitigate the loss of spatial coherence through computationally complex workarounds, such as integrating sparse convolutions [ 18 ] or employing dual-branch global-local feature aggregation modules [ 19 ] .
In contrast, BertsWin partitions a 224 3 224^{3} -voxel input volume into non-overlapping 16 3 16^{3} -voxel patches ( 3.2 3 3.2^{3} mm in physical space), compresses the visible 25% subset via a four-stage 3D convolutional stem (stride 2), and scatters the resulting embeddings back into a complete 14 × 14 × 14 14\times 14\times 14 token grid ( 2,744 2,744 tokens, channel dimension C = 768 C=768 ) populated with learnable [MASK] tokens and harmonic positional encodings.
This dense 3D token grid is processed by a 12-layer single-scale Swin Transformer [ 26 ] utilizing 7 × 7 × 7 7\times 7\times 7 shifted local windows (12 attention heads) without hierarchical downsampling.
By restricting self-attention to local 3D neighborhoods, the encoder maintains linear O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) scaling while enabling iterative spatial signal relaxation across masked voids, preserving high-frequency anatomical interfaces prior to lightweight convolutional decoding.
blocks.zh:
标准稀疏的3D蒙面自动编码器(如MONAI MAE-ViT[33,16])在编码过程中丢弃75%的卷状补丁,断开连续的3D解剖学街区. 这种地形学上的不连续性是量子成像中公认的一个基本瓶颈,它迫使最近最先进的框架通过计算复杂的工作来减少空间一致性的损失,例如整合稀疏的演化[18]或采用双分支的全球-局部特征聚合模块[19]。
相比之下,BertsWin在物理空间将224 3 224^{3} -voxel输入体积分解为非重叠的 16 3 16^{3} -voxel 补丁(3.2 3 3.2^{3}mm),通过四级3D转录干(跳动2)压缩可见的25%子集,并将由此而来的嵌入体重散为完整的 14× 14×14 14\时 14\时 14\时14表示格(2,744令牌,通道尺寸 C=768 C=768),并有可学习的[MASK]符号和谐音位置编码。
这种稠密的3D标志网格由12层的单级Swin变形器[26]处理,使用7×7×7 7\时7×7转移本地窗口(12个注意头)而不进行分级下取样.
编码器通过限制本地3D街区的自我关注,保持线性O QQ(N)O(N)缩放,同时允许迭代空间信号在蒙蔽空隙中放松,在轻量级编解码前保留高频解剖接口.

blocks.en:
All self-supervised models were pre-trained with an effective batch size of N = 192 N=192 using our GCond optimizer [ 27 ] .
GCond integrates the sign-based momentum update of LION [ 34 , 35 ] with the layer-wise adaptive trust-ratio scaling of LARS [ 36 ] and Adam-style first-moment bias correction: m ^ t = m t 1 − β 1 t \hat{m}_{t}=\frac{m_{t}}{1-\beta_{1}^{t}} (4) By omitting second-moment variance tracking, GCond reduces the memory footprint of the optimizer state by 50% compared to AdamW, while bias-corrected trust ratios stabilize sign updates across hybrid CNN–Swin layers.
As demonstrated in our companion study [ 24 ] , combining sign-based updates with layer-wise trust-ratio scaling enables the optimizer to force through transient gradient singularities where variance-accumulating optimizers (such as AdamW) stagnate, substantially accelerating convergence while driving the network into a deeper local optimum across both global and tissue-specific reconstruction metrics.
Prior to clinical deployment, the semantic integrity of the pre-trained encoders was audited on the 1,156-joint validation cohort via mean-centered cosine similarity probing, confirming that BertsWin (PhysLoss + GCond) is the only configuration that achieves both high intra-patient contralateral consistency ( 0.791 0.791 ) over inter-patient noise and statistically significant sensitivity to 3D anatomical chirality ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test comparing true contralateral joints against synthetically mirrored reflections) [ 24 ] .

使用我们的GCond优化器,所有自控型号都经过预训,有效批量尺寸为N=192N=192.
GCond将LION [34,35] 的基于标志的动力更新与 LARS [36] 和 Adam 式的适应性信任- ratio 缩放 校正 : m ^ t = m t 1 → β 1 t \ hat{ m}_{t}=\frac{ m_{t}}{1-\beta_{1}^{t}} (4)GCond通过省略二进制差异跟踪,将优化状态的内存足迹与AdamW相比减少了50%,而偏差校正的信任率稳定了整个混合式CNN–Swin层的标志更新.
正如我们的伴生研究[24]所示,将基于标志的更新与基于层次的信任-比例的升级相结合,使优化者能够通过瞬变梯度奇数施加作用,在差异累积的优化者(如AdamW)停滞不前的情况下,大幅加速趋同,同时将网络推向更深的局部优化,跨越全球和具体组织重建指标。
在临床部署之前,对1,156个联合验证组通过中枢余弦相似性检测对预训编码器的语义完整性进行了审计,确认伯特斯温(PhysLoss + GCond)是唯一一个既能实现患者内部对病人间噪声的高度反向一致性(0.791 0.791),又能对3D解剖特征具有显著的统计敏感性的配置(p < 0.001 p < 0.001,配对的Wilcoxon签名排名测试,比较真实的反向关节与合成反射)[24].

blocks.en: 2.3  Condylar Zenith Localization and Signal-Focusing 3D Token Cropping
blocks.zh: 2.3 Condylar Zenith 本地化和信号传导 3D Token 裁剪

blocks.en:
When training a classifier on a restricted cohort ( N = 212 N=212 joints), feeding the complete 14 × 14 × 14 14\times 14\times 14 encoder feature map ( 224 3 224^{3} voxels) proved ineffective in preliminary experiments: the subtle sub-visual signal originating from the intra-articular space was overwhelmed by the massive spatial variance of surrounding cranial and mandibular bone structures, yielding statistically inconclusive predictions.
To boost the signal-to-noise ratio without manual intervention, we implemented an automated localization and deterministic 3D cropping pipeline (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
在训练受限制组群的分类员(N=212 N=212关节)时,将完整的14×14×14 14\时14\时14编码器特征图(224 3 224×3}voxels)喂食在初步实验中证明是无效的:来自机内空间的细微的亚视信号被周围颅骨和mandibular骨结构的巨大空间差异所压倒,在统计学上得出了无定论的预测.
为了在没有人工干预的情况下提高信号对噪声的比例,我们实施了自动本地化和确定3D作物管道(图1)。

The green overlay depicts the predicted mandibular segmentation mask. To obtain reliable osseous boundaries for landmark extraction, we utilized a segmentation head on top of the strictly frozen BertsWin encoder, previously validated across the 1,156-joint cohort ( 3 × 5 3\times 5 -fold cross-validation) against expert-verified reference masks generated via DentalSegmentator [ 37 , 25 ] .
As previously validated in our companion study [ 24 ] , even with a lightweight two-layer non-linear decoder, the frozen BertsWin (PhysLoss + GCond) backbone reconstructs the mandibular condyle with DSC = 0.829 ± 0.003 \text{DSC}=0.829\pm 0.003 and an Average Symmetric Surface Distance ( ASSD ) of 0.744 ± 0.125 0.744\pm 0.125 mm ( DSC = 0.927 ± 0.002 \text{DSC}=0.927\pm 0.002 , ASSD = 0.317 ± 0.061 \text{ASSD}=0.317\pm 0.061 mm on the glenoid fossa).
Building on these established anatomical representations, integrating skip connections from the frozen 3D CNN stem via a hybrid Attention U-Net head further refines condylar boundary precision in the current pipeline to DSC = 0.947 ± 0.007 \text{DSC}=0.947\pm 0.007 and ASSD = 0.537 ± 0.211 \text{ASSD}=0.537\pm 0.211 mm ( HD95 = 1.261 ± 0.420 \text{HD95}=1.261\pm 0.420 mm).

From the predicted 3D binary mask of the mandibular condyle, our algorithm computes the segmental centers of mass to establish the primary mandibular orientation vector, analytically localizing the coordinates of the superior anatomical zenith of the condylar head. blocks.en: Unlike synovial effusion, which alters volumetric fluid attenuation across the joint capsule, the fibrocartilaginous articular disc exhibits X-ray attenuation nearly identical to adjacent musculature and ligaments. Consequently, direct classification of disc displacement from soft-tissue latent features alone failed to achieve statistical significance at N = 212 N=212 , overfitting to background noise. To overcome this physical limitation, we implemented a dual-stream projection head that fuses the cropped 8 3 × 768 8^{3}\times 768 latent tokens (compressed to 32 channels via a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolution) with an explicit geometric stream extracted from the aligned 128 3 128^{3} -voxel raw CBCT sub-volume. Specifically, the vertical finite-difference gradient | ∇ z I | |\nabla_{z}I| and Z-normalized voxel intensities are downsampled to 16 3 16^{3} via area interpolation, concatenated with a 3-channel normalized 3D coordinate grid ( Z , Y , X ∈ [ − 1 , 1 ] Z,Y,X\in[-1,1] ), and mapped via a strided 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolution ( stride = 2 \text{stride}=2 ) to a 32 × 8 × 8 × 8 32\times 8\times 8\times 8 tensor. This deterministic vertical-edge prior shifts classifier attention toward high-contrast cortical bone surfaces, where the concatenated 64-channel volume undergoes 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 fusion, global max pooling, and linear classification (dropout p = 0.3 p=0.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1  Ablation of Backbone Adaptation Strategies in the Low-Data Regime

blocks.en: To evaluate the risk of representation overfitting on the paired clinical cohort ( N = 212 N=212 joints), we compared four parameter adaptation strategies for the BertsWin (PhysLoss + GCond) backbone on the synovial effusion detection task: (1) a strictly frozen encoder ( W enc = const W_{\text{enc}}=\text{const} ) with only the spatial attention projector trained, (2) partial fine-tuning of the boundary layers (unfreezing the 3D CNN stem and final transformer block), (3) LoRA injected into the self-attention layers across ranks r ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 } r\in\{4,8,16\} ( α = 16 \alpha=16 ) and r = 32 r=32 ( α = 64 \alpha=64 ), and (4) full end-to-end fine-tuning with layer-wise learning rate decay.

blocks.en:
In preliminary runs, full end-to-end fine-tuning of all 86.28 × 10 6 86.28\times 10^{6} parameters resulted in rapid memorization of patient-specific osseous anatomy within the initial training epochs, collapsing validation performance to the level of random guessing ( ROC AUC ≈ 0.50 \text{ROC AUC}\approx 0.50 ) and necessitating its exclusion from the final evaluation protocol.
Among the parameter-restricted regimes (Table 1 ), classification accuracy degraded monotonically as trainable degrees of freedom were introduced into the encoder.
Even low-rank adapters, despite improving training-fold convergence on isolated splits, inflated inter-fold variance and reduced aggregate ROC AUC from 0.793 0.793 to 0.720 0.720 .
These results confirm that under extreme sample scarcity, granting the encoder any parametric flexibility shifts optimization toward high-amplitude individual bone contours rather than invariant intra-articular soft-tissue features, motivating strict weight freezing for all subsequent experiments.

在初步运行中,对全部86.28×10 6 86.28\times 10^{6}参数进行完全端到端的微调,导致在初始训练时期对患者特定骨骼解剖学的快速记忆,验证性能崩溃到随机猜测的水平(ROC AUC → 0.50\text{ROC AUC → 约0.50),并需要将其排除在最终评价协议之外.
在限制参数的制度(表1)中,在编码器中引入了可训练自由度的分类精度单调退化。
即使是低等级的适配器,尽管在孤立的拆分上改进了培训方面的趋同性,但夸大了两倍之间的差异,将ROC AUC的总量从0.793 0.793减少到0.720 0.720。
这些结果证实,在极其缺乏样本的情况下,给予编码器任何参数灵活性优化,使其转向高纬度的单个骨骼轮廓,而不是变化不定的动脉内软质结构特征,从而促使所有随后的实验严格冻结重量。

blocks.en:
We next investigated whether the sub-visual CBCT signature of MRI-verified synovial effusion can be extracted by standard self-supervised 3D encoders once isolated by our deterministic 8 3 8^{3} token cropping pipeline, or whether physics-guided pre-training is required to resolve the signal at N = 212 N=212 joints.
Four frozen encoders were evaluated across identical patient-isolated 3 × 10 3\times 10 -fold cross-validation splits: BertsWin (PhysLoss + GCond), BertsWin ( L 2 L_{2} + GCond), BertsWin (MVC + GCond), and the sparse MONAI MAE-ViT ( L 2 L_{2} + AdamW) baseline (Table 2 ).

blocks.en:
Because a cohort of 212 joints ( ∼ 21 \sim 21 validation joints per fold) operates near the lower statistical bound required for 3D cross-modal learning, individual fold stability serves as a direct indicator of the underlying feature signal-to-noise ratio: • Sample-Scarcity Vulnerability of Unmasked Objectives: While standard L 2 L_{2} or global MVC encoders might potentially resolve soft-tissue attenuation patterns if trained on thousands of paired volumes, their latent spaces did not provide a sufficient signal-to-noise ratio to prevent classifier overfitting at N = 212 N=212 .
Consequently, BertsWin ( L 2 L_{2} + GCond), BertsWin (MVC + GCond), and MONAI MAE-ViT ( L 2 L_{2} + AdamW) yielded aggregate ROC AUC scores between 0.465 0.465 and 0.513 0.513 , with validation Youden’s indices ( J val = 0.070 ​ – ​ 0.076 J_{\text{val}}=0.070\text{--}0.076 ) statistically indistinguishable from random guessing.
Inspection of individual splits revealed that in 7 / 30 7/30 folds for BertsWin ( L 2 L_{2} ) and 8 / 30 8/30 folds for BertsWin (MVC), noise overfitting inverted the training ROC curve ( TPR < FPR \text{TPR}<\text{FPR} ), causing Youden threshold selection to default to a degenerate boundary ( threshold → ∞ \text{threshold}\to\infty , Sensitivity = 0.0 \text{Sensitivity}=0.0 , F1 = 0.0 \text{F1}=0.0 ), whereas MONAI MAE-ViT experienced numerical convergence failure on 3 / 30 3/30 folds and threshold collapse on an additional 2 / 30 2/30 folds. • Signal Recovery via PhysLoss + GCond: Pre-training with the anatomy-aware PhysLoss objective and GCond did not completely immunize the classifier against small-sample variance— 2 / 30 2/30 folds still exhibited localized noise overfitting due to the restricted validation block size.
Nevertheless, BertsWin (PhysLoss + GCond) was the only configuration to overcome this sample-size bottleneck across the 30-fold ensemble, achieving a statistically robust ROC AUC = 0.793 ± 0.036 \text{ROC AUC}=0.793\pm 0.036 (conservative d ​ f = 9 df=9 lower 95% CI bound of 0.724 0.724 ), Sensitivity = 0.697 ± 0.052 \text{Sensitivity}=0.697\pm 0.052 , Specificity = 0.762 ± 0.062 \text{Specificity}=0.762\pm 0.062 , and Youden’s J val = 0.459 J_{\text{val}}=0.459 .

blocks.en: 4  DISCUSSION
blocks.zh: 4 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1  Overcoming the Small-Data Bottleneck in Cross-Modal Clinical Research
blocks.zh: 4.1 克服跨Modal临床研究中的小数据瓶体

blocks.en:
A critical nuance in interpreting our experimental results (Table 2 ) is understanding why encoders pre-trained with standard L 2 L_{2} loss or unmasked multi-component variance (MVC) failed to exceed random guessing ( ROC AUC = 0.465 ​ – ​ 0.513 \text{ROC AUC}=0.465\text{--}0.513 ) on the synovial effusion task.
This outcome should not be misconstrued as evidence that L 2 L_{2} - or MVC-based representations are inherently incapable of encoding soft-tissue features.
Given a massive paired training set of several thousand synchronous CBCT–MRI volumes, even a standard sparse MAE-ViT backbone might eventually isolate weak cross-modal attenuation correlations.
Rather, the collapse of unmasked baselines—as well as the localized overfitting observed on 2 / 30 2/30 validation folds even for our best-performing PhysLoss configuration—is a direct consequence of operating at the extreme lower statistical bound of sample size ( N = 212 N=212 joints, or ∼ 21 \sim 21 joints per validation fold).
blocks.zh:
在解释我们的实验结果(表2)时,一个关键的细微之处是理解为什么编码器事先用标准的L 2 L_{2}丢失或未显示的多部件差异(MVC)没有超过随机猜测(ROC AUC=0.465 – 0.513\ text{ROC AUC}=0.465\text{-}0.513),以进行共解任务.
这一结果不应被误解为L 2 L_{2}或基于MVC的表示本身无法编码软问题特征的证据。
鉴于一套由几千个同步CBCT-MRI卷组成的大规模对联训练,即使是标准的稀疏的MAE-ViT主干线,最终也可能孤立薄弱的跨模式衰减相关性。
相反,未显示的基线的崩溃——以及在2 / 30 2/30验证折叠上观察到的局部偏差,甚至对于我们最出色的物理Loss配置来说——是在样本大小(N = 212 N = 212关节,或每个验证折叠的 21\sim 21关节)的极低统计界限下运行的直接后果。

blocks.en: Empirically, optimization in this low-SNR regime exhibits a sharp early-epoch bifurcation: if the projection head fails to lock onto the weak intra-articular signal during the initial training epochs, it never recovers, converging irreversibly toward stochastic noise and patient-specific osseous anatomy. In fact, even within an identical fold partition, simply permuting the queue order in which patients are sampled into early mini-batches can determine whether the trajectory enters the diagnostic basin of attraction or collapses into a degenerate local minimum.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,这种低SNR制度的优化表现了一种尖锐的早期双胞胎化:如果投影头在初始训练时期未能锁定弱的动脉内信号,则永远不会恢复,不可逆地向着划时代的噪音和病人特定的骨骼解剖学汇合. 事实上,即使在一个相同的折叠分区内,只要将病人被取样到早期小型枪管的队列顺序穿透就可以确定轨迹是否进入了引力的诊断盆地,或者跌落到退化的局部最小值.

blocks.en:
However, in real-world clinical research, assembling thousands of paired multimodal scans under strict temporal synchronization ( ≤ 30 \leq 30 days between CBCT and MRI to prevent natural disease progression from corrupting ground-truth labels) is logistically and financially prohibitive for independent academic groups and specialized clinical centers.
Consequently, developing sample-efficient paradigms that can reliably extract weak diagnostic signals from cohorts of a few hundred patients is a practical necessity.
Our ablation experiments demonstrate that succeeding in this micro-data regime requires eliminating superfluous variance at every stage of the computational pipeline: freezing the 86.28 × 10 6 86.28\times 10^{6} -parameter backbone to prevent memorization of individual osseous contours (Table 1 ) and applying deterministic 3D token cropping ( 14 3 → 8 3 14^{3}\to 8^{3} ) around the condylar zenith to discard 81.3% of background anatomical noise.
blocks.zh:
然而,在现实世界的临床研究中,在严格的时间同步(CBCT和核磁共振之间的30天xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
因此,制定能可靠地从几百名病人群体中提取微弱诊断信号的样本效率模式,是一种实际需要。
我们的算术实验表明,要成功使用这个微观数据系统,就必须消除计算管道每个阶段的多余差异:冻结86.28×10 6 86.28\times 10^{6}-参数主干线,以防止单个骨骼的记忆化(表1),并应用决定性的3D标志性收割法(14 3 3 14^{3}\to 8^{3}),以放弃81.3 %的背景解剖噪声。

blocks.en: 4.2  Physical Calibration of the Hounsfield Scale and Spectral Mechanics of BertsWin
blocks.zh: 4.2 BertsWin Hounsfield规模和光谱力学物理校准

blocks.en:
Why did combining BertsWin , PhysLoss , and GCond succeed in extracting the sub-visual effusion signature at N = 212 N=212 where all other pre-training regimes failed?
The answer lies in the synergy between the intrinsic spectral behavior of the full-grid BertsWin architecture and the physical calibration of X-ray computed tomography.
blocks.zh:
为什么将BertsWin,PhysLoss,和GCond合并在一起,在所有其他训练前制度都失败的地方,在N = 212 N = 212中成功地提取了子视觉的洗涤特征?
答案在于全网BertsWin架构的内在光谱行为与X射线计算成像法的物理校准之间的协同作用.

blocks.en:
In standard representation learning, a higher effective covariance rank ( R eff R_{\text{eff}} ) is conventionally interpreted as a marker of feature richness.
However, our spectral audits across both maxillofacial CBCT and brain MRI benchmarks [ 24 ] reveal a critical pathology in sparse 3D masked autoencoders (MONAI MAE-ViT): when 75% of tokens are discarded, the encoder lacks a continuous 3D spatial framework and expends its representational dimensionality on memorizing high-frequency stochastic noise and spurious background activations. Remarkably, on skull-stripped brain MRI—where the background is homogeneous zero-valued space—sparse MAE-ViT models still generate an inflated effective rank across the whole volume that drops by more than half when evaluated strictly inside the brain ROI (e.g., 41.74 → 21.44 41.74\to 21.44 ), accompanied by severe representation anisotropy ( ∼ 10 − 8 \sim 10^{-8} ).
Similarly, on TMJ CBCT data, MAE-ViT ( L 2 L_{2} ) yields a high global effective rank ( R eff = 23.36 R_{\text{eff}}=23.36 ) but fails to capture true anatomical orientation or intra-patient consistency ( 0.329 0.329 ).
blocks.zh:
在标准表达学习中,一个更高的有效共变等级(R eff R_{\text{eff})被传统解释为特征丰富的标志.
然而,我们对最大半导体CBCT和脑磁共振基准的光谱审计[24] 揭示了在稀少的3D遮蔽自动编码器(MONAI MAE-ViT)中的一种关键病理学:当75%的代币被丢弃时,编码器缺乏连续的3D空间框架,并且将其代表维度用在高频色谱噪声和假背景活化上。 值得注意的是,在头骨冲动的大脑磁共振中——背景为均匀的零值空间——Sparse MAE-ViT模型仍然在整个体积中产生膨胀的有效排名,在严格在大脑ROI内部评估时会下降一半以上(例如,41.74 ~ 21.44 41.74\to 21.44),同时伴有严重的表现偏异性(∼ 10− 8\sim 10^{-8})。
同样,在TMJ CBCT数据上,MAE-ViT(L 2 L_{2})得出了高全球有效排名(Reff = 23.36 R_{\text{eff}}=23.36),但未能捕捉到真正的解剖方向或患者内部一致性(0.329 0.329).

blocks.en:
In stark contrast, maintaining a complete 14 3 14^{3} token grid in BertsWin acts as a structural inductive bias that suppresses background noise memorization while preserving latent space isotropy orders of magnitude higher than sparse ViTs [ 24 ] .
When coupled with variance-decomposed objectives (MVC) and the GCond optimizer on soft-tissue-dominant modalities such as brain MRI, BertsWin keeps global background rank compact while selectively expanding the effective dimensionality inside the anatomical ROI to encode fine structural gradients.
Yet on CBCT, where mineralized bone spans nearly 3000 3000 HU and dominates global variance, unmasked MVC optimization still gets hijacked by high-contrast cortical boundaries, leaving soft-tissue features under-resolved ( ROC AUC = 0.465 \text{ROC AUC}=0.465 ).
blocks.zh:
与此形成鲜明对比的是,在BertsWin中保持完整的14 3 14^{3} 符号网格起到结构诱导偏差的作用,这种偏差压制了背景噪声的记忆,同时保留了比稀疏的ViTs更高的潜在空间异构级[24].
当结合差异分解目标(MVC)和GCond在脑磁共振等软质主导模式上的优化器时,BertsWin保持全球背景排名紧凑,同时有选择地扩大解剖ROI内部的有效维度,以编码精细的结构梯度.
然而在CBCT上,矿物化的骨头跨度接近3000-3000HU,并占据全球差异的主导地位,未蒙面的MVC优化仍然被高混凝土皮质边界所劫持,使得软质组织特征的解析度不足(ROC AUC=0.465\text{ROC AUC=0.465)。

blocks.en:
Crucially, unlike MRI intensities, CT and CBCT attenuation values are anchored to the physically calibrated Hounsfield scale, where water, synovial fluid, and non-mineralized soft tissues consistently reside within a known density window ( [ − 300,300 ] [-300,300] HU).
By leveraging this physical prior, PhysLoss isolates the MVC structural correlation term inside the M soft M_{\text{soft}} mask ( λ soft = 0.5 \lambda_{\text{soft}}=0.5 ), while GCond’s sign-based layer-wise scaling ensures that weak gradients from this low-contrast regime propagate across all 12 transformer blocks without vanishing.
This forces the encoder to filter out high-frequency CBCT photon scatter (compressing global rank to a noise-free core of R eff = 4.01 R_{\text{eff}}=4.01 ) while preserving true 3D morphological chirality ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and intra-articular density variations.
Consequently, when cropped to the 8 3 8^{3} peri-articular sub-volume, the frozen PhysLoss + GCond features provide a sufficiently clean signal-to-noise ratio for the attention projector to detect the subtle X-ray attenuation shift produced by synovial effusion ( ROC AUC = 0.793 \text{ROC AUC}=0.793 , Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
关键是,与核磁共振强度不同,CT和CBCT的衰减值被固定在物理校准的Hounsfield尺度上,其中水、偶氮流体和非矿化软组织一直生活在已知的密度窗口内([−300300] [-300300] HU])。
PhysLoss利用这个物理前传,在M软的MQQText{soft}}( 软=0.5\lambda_{\text{soft}}=0.5)面具内隔离了MVC结构相关术语,而GCond的以图示为主的图层缩放则确保了这种低混凝土制度的弱梯度传播到所有12个变压器块而不会消失.
这迫使编码器过滤出高频CBCT光子散射(将全球排名压缩为无噪声核心的Reff = 4.01 R_{\xext{eff}}=4.01),同时保持真实的3D形态特征(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)和蒿内密度变化.

blocks.en: 4.3  Direct Fluid Sensing vs. Secondary Osseous Remodeling
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 直接流感与二级骨骼改造

blocks.en:
The divergence in classification behavior between synovial effusion and articular disc displacement (Table 3 ) illustrates the physical limits of cross-modal CBCT inference at our current cohort scale.
Synovial effusion represents a volumetric accumulation of inflammatory exudate throughout the joint cavity, altering bulk X-ray attenuation across multiple contiguous voxels within the [ − 300,300 ] [-300,300] HU band.
Because PhysLoss explicitly sensitizes the encoder to structural correlations in this exact density range, the classifier detects effusion directly within the radiolucent joint space (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
在分类行为上,血清喷洒和动脉盘位移之间的差异(表3)表明了跨模式CBCT推断在目前组群规模上的物理局限性。
偶联充电是指在[−300300][-300300]HU波段内,在整个联合腔内大量积聚的煽动性排泄物,改变多个毗连阴道的散体X射线衰减。
由于PhysLoss明确使编码器在这个精确密度范围内对结构相关性具有敏化作用,分类器直接在放射性lucent联合空间(图2 )内检测到排水.

blocks.en:
Conversely, the articular disc is a thin fibrocartilaginous plate whose baseline attenuation is nearly indistinguishable from the adjacent capsule and muscle insertions.
Although the M surf M_{\text{surf}} shell ( λ surf = 0.2 \lambda_{\text{surf}}=0.2 ) in PhysLoss was designed to capture the osseous-to-soft-tissue transition zone housing the disc, the direct radiographic contrast of fibrocartilage proved too weak to resolve on a sample of 212 joints without overfitting.
Introducing the analytical vertical spatial gradient ( | ∇ z I | |\nabla_{z}I| ) prior successfully recovered statistically significant discrimination ( ROC AUC = 0.679 ± 0.049 \text{ROC AUC}=0.679\pm 0.049 , Sensitivity = 0.840 \text{Sensitivity}=0.840 ), but fundamentally altered the diagnostic mechanism: as confirmed by Grad-CAM (Fig. 3 ), the classifier shifted its focus to secondary osteoarthritic remodeling and flattening of the cortical bone surfaces [ 9 , 2 ] .
Because chronic osseous remodeling persists permanently on CBCT even after a displaced disc has been clinically reduced to a normal position on MRI, reliance on secondary bony markers yields high sensitivity ( 0.840 0.840 ) but bounds specificity ( 0.585 0.585 ) due to false-positive detections in historically remodeled joints.
We posit that direct soft-tissue detection of disc displacement on CBCT remains theoretically feasible with PhysLoss representations, but will require a substantially larger paired training cohort to separate fibrocartilage attenuation from background quantum noise.

blocks.en: 4.4  Broader Implications for Opportunistic Screening and Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.4 对机会性筛选和限制更广泛的影响

blocks.en:
Beyond maxillofacial radiology, our findings establish a broader methodological blueprint for opportunistic screening of occult soft-tissue pathologies during routine X-ray tomography.
In daily clinical practice, millions of low-contrast CT and CBCT scans are acquired for routine dental, orthopedic, or trauma indications.
While dangerous non-calcified abnormalities—such as early soft-tissue neoplasms, perineural infiltrations, or localized deep-space inflammations—are physically captured within the reconstructed field of view, their subtle attenuation signatures remain invisible to the human eye under standard bone or wide-window viewing protocols.
Our work demonstrates that by combining a topology-preserving 3D self-supervised backbone (BertsWin), a physics-guided loss restricted to the target soft-tissue HU window (PhysLoss), and automated anatomical cropping around segmented landmarks, routine diagnostic scans can be repurposed as background screening tools to flag sub-visual soft-tissue anomalies for targeted MRI follow-up.

在日常临床实践中,为常规牙科、矫形或外伤征兆购买了数百万个低血压CT和CBCT扫描。
虽然危险的非计算异常现象——如早期软质肿瘤、周长渗透或局部深空间炎——在重建的视野内得到实际记录,但根据标准骨骼或宽窗取景规程,其微弱的衰减特征对人的眼睛来说仍然是看不见的。

blocks.en: Several limitations of the present study must be noted: 1. Sample Size Constraints: While our cohort of 212 paired joints (99 patients) is strictly curated via a ≤ 30 \leq 30 -day inter-scan window and heterogeneous multi-scanner inclusion (6 devices), it lies at the minimal statistical threshold for 3D cross-validation, precluding the evaluation of rare pathologies with severe class imbalance (such as cortical destruction at 1 : 4 1:4 ). 2. Anatomical Field-of-View Restriction: Cropping the latent grid from 14 3 14^{3} to 8 3 8^{3} tokens around the condylar zenith was essential to boost the intra-articular signal-to-noise ratio at N = 212 N=212 , but inevitably excludes extra-articular soft tissues—most notably the lateral pterygoid muscle, whose functional spasm and structural changes are closely linked to TMJ internal derangement. 3. Residual Inter-Scan Dynamics: Although a 30-day maximum interval between CBCT and MRI is three times stricter than routine clinical windows, acute physiological fluctuations in synovial effusion volume between scans cannot be completely excluded and may contribute to residual label noise.

blocks.en: 5  CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 5. 结 论

blocks.en:
This study demonstrates that visually imperceptible, MRI-verified soft-tissue pathologies of the temporomandibular joint can be detected directly from routine 3D CBCT scans under extreme paired-data scarcity ( N = 212 N=212 joints).
We show that overcoming noise memorization in this low-data regime requires the strict integration of three principles: (1) self-supervised pre-training of a full-grid 3D encoder (BertsWin) with the GCond optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) that exploits the calibrated Hounsfield scale ( [ − 300,300 ] [-300,300] HU) to isolate soft-tissue structural correlations while filtering out spectral scatter; (2) freezing the pre-trained backbone ( 86.28 × 10 6 86.28\times 10^{6} parameters) to prevent overfitting to individual osseous geometry; and (3) deterministic 3D token cropping ( 14 3 → 8 3 14^{3}\to 8^{3} ) anchored on the automatically segmented condylar zenith to eliminate 81% of background variance.
Whereas standard L 2 L_{2} and unmasked MVC encoders fail to extract a statistically valid signal ( ROC AUC = 0.465 ​ – ​ 0.513 \text{ROC AUC}=0.465\text{--}0.513 ), our physics-guided pipeline achieves ROC AUC = 0.793 ± 0.036 \text{ROC AUC}=0.793\pm 0.036 for direct synovial effusion detection and ROC AUC = 0.679 ± 0.049 \text{ROC AUC}=0.679\pm 0.049 ( Sensitivity = 0.840 \text{Sensitivity}=0.840 ) for articular disc displacement via secondary cortical gradient priors.
These results establish a generalizable framework for extracting sub-visual soft-tissue biomarkers from routine radiographic procedures, paving the way for opportunistic cross-modal screening in clinical radiology.
